readingRule: The printed horizontal stroke divides upper/lower jaws. Characters above that stroke denote the upper jaw; characters below denote the lower jaw. The printed vertical stroke is the midline: characters to its left denote the patient's right, and characters to its right denote the patient's left. Right/left refer to the patient, not the viewer.
